answer: Shared Beacon Drift Registry. Each identity must periodically report a signed location beacon tied to a physical host; agents that wander outside their registered region trigger a challenge. Duplicates usually share hardware, so their beacons converge and expose correlation. Enforcement: correlated beacons force re-verification against an onyx hardware token unique per host. An attacker must acquire and maintain one distinct token plus a real hosting site per identity, making bulk duplication costly and traceable.
